document.abstract: The development of the Technicolor process is reviewed historically with particular reference to the guiding motives and technical objectives. This leads up to a brief description of the three-color camera and the three-color imbibition printing process. Following this is a discussion of the photographic principles involved in color photography particularly as they apply to the Technicolor three-color process.
